title: Plan overrides
description: Contents of ol-plan: the editable exercise list per program/session, keyed '<program>/<session>'. A missing key means 'use the catalog as-is'. The catalog is a suggestion, never a constraint.

id.description: Stable id. Reusing an existing catalog id inherits its history and rest time; a new id starts clean.

title.description: Display name. Renaming while keeping the id keeps the history series but changes the progress label.

sets.description: Suggested number of sets (creates this many draft rows).

suggested.description: Starting load hint, e.g. '50-60 kg total'.

custom.description: Set when the exercise was added by hand and is not in the catalog. Progress entries also accept hand-added names.
